_comment: API address on the LAN. This Mac's address works from the Mac itself and from any device on the same VLAN, so one file covers both targets. Pass it with: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=config/lan.json
_warning: This Mac is on DHCP (lease 192.168.10.26, 24h). If the lease changes, update this value and android/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml. A DHCP reservation on the router at 192.168.10.1 avoids that.
